speaker: Devotee (tasting)
question: Where ceaselessly fresh?
premises: Ah, sweetest is the nectar-taste of hoping to serve Śarva.
Where in a mere digit of time does it not become ever-fresh?
inference: Service-hope's nectar is ever-fresh at every instant.

speaker: Devotee (exulting victory)
question: Who conquers untiring?
premises: Again and again untiring, three worlds with hundreds of imaginings imagining even.
Who yet one, undifferentiated, conquers — unborn.
inference: Untiring imaginer, one, undifferentiated, unborn conquers.

option_choices.reason: Conquers (3sg conquers imagining); victory-exclamation same jayati, T1 kept.

speaker: Devotee (pleading presence)
question: When present to you?
premises: By the knowledge-lamp burning the wick of transmigration-latencies anointed with stain-oil.
O god, when to you may I be present, pray?
inference: By knowledge-lamp burning latencies, may I be present to you?

speaker: Devotee (bargaining wink)
question: What will you not accomplish?
premises: Even one wink, if fault-waned you make foot in mind.
Then, O Śambhu, what will you not accomplish?
inference: One faultless wink of mind-foot accomplishes all.

option_choices.reason: Foot (make foot/step in mind); state/condition same pada, T1 foot kept.

speaker: Devotee (claiming blessedness)
question: Whose conviction stands?
premises: 'Blessed I am, duty done I am, great I am' — thus conviction.
Would be with-support — his who has you as support, O lord.
inference: Blessed-done-great conviction stands supported by you.

option_choices.reason: With-support (grounded conviction); supported same sālambana, T1 kept.

speaker: Devotee (distinguishing mothers)
question: What mothers only auspicious?
premises: Of all auspicious and inauspicious yourself the doer you are.
But devotion to you is mother of auspicious alone, O lord, only.
inference: You do all; devotion mothers only auspicious.

speaker: Devotee (swinging in doubt)
question: Do you enter, or does it clear?
premises: When mind is clear, O master — do you enter, or from your entering does it clear.
Thus the person swings.
inference: Entering vs clearing — the person swings between.

inference: Certainty: supervised by you alone; grace is accomplishment, supreme state.

option_choices.reason: Supervision-by-you (adhiṣṭhāna oversight resolving doubt); support same resting, T1 kept.

speaker: Devotee (offering all)
question: What be ornamented?
premises: Speech and mind and deed and my body — which, O lord.
By your grace may that be ornamented alone with devotion to you.
inference: May speech, mind, deed, body be ornamented with devotion.

speaker: Bhaṭṭanārāyaṇa (colophon)
question: Who made this wish-jewel?
premises: The wish-jewel of praise, giving rich fruits of wishes.
Abode of devotion's fortune — O Śambhu — Bhaṭṭanārāyaṇa made.
inference: Bhaṭṭanārāyaṇa made this devotion-jewel for Śambhu.
